facts.summary: Phase 3 failed overall survival primary endpoint · Phase 3 · uproleselan in relapsed/refractory AML · not yet approved

evidence.summary: In the study, uproleselan combined with chemotherapy did not achieve a statistically significant improvement in overall survival in the intent to treat population versus chemotherapy alone.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Study of uproleselan combined with chemotherapy did not meet its primary endpoint of overall survival in the intent to treat population
evidence.safety: Adverse events were consistent with known side effect profiles of chemotherapy used in the study.
